tagline: 美能达胶片相机，1972 年发布
description: 美能达于1972年推出的胶片相机。配备Rokkor 1:3.5/23 mm with 3 elements, focusing 1.2m to infinity。快门速度Speeds 1/30 and 1/250 sec.。使用Minolta 16 mm film with speeds 50 to 400 ASA。

specs.胶片/画幅: Minolta 16 mm film with speeds 50 to 400 ASA
specs.镜头: Rokkor 1:3.5/23 mm with 3 elements, focusing 1.2m to infinity
specs.取景器: optical with LED indicators for under and over exposure and shutter speed setting, symbols and indicator for zone-focusing and warning bar for camera shake.
specs.电池: 1 3v. PX-30 or 2 1.5v PX-825 alkaline type batteries
specs.英文简介: The Minolta 16 QT was the last camera made for Minolta's 16mm film cartridges.
